paragraphs.source_en: News of Sen no Rikyū's banishment spread through the capital at once. At the direction of Ishida Jibu-shōyū Mitsunari, Uesugi Kagekatsu's men completely surrounded Rikyū's residence in Yoshiyamachi, so naturally everyone soon knew of it. To the people of the capital, it was a bolt from the blue.

paragraphs.source_en: The layman Rikyū had enjoyed Hideyoshi's exceptional favor: Hideyoshi entrusted public affairs to his younger brother Hidenaga and his private affairs entirely to Rikyū.
